rules: Do not copy large implementation blocks from reference-openclaw.
Implement product code only under dominic-nexus.
Keep documentation and planning changes under docs.
Run the narrowest relevant check after code changes.
Default security posture is deny-by-default with explicit approval for risky actions.

statusLegend.done: Task is complete in the current baseline or completed by the planning update.
statusLegend.todo: Task is ready or waiting for dependencies.
statusLegend.blocked: Task cannot start until an external decision or missing dependency is resolved.
statusLegend.deferred: Task is intentionally postponed until the core runtime is stable.

selectionPolicy: Choose the lowest-phase todo task whose dependencies are done.
Prefer P0 tasks before P1 and P2 tasks.
Keep reference inspection narrow and summarize new findings into docs.

tasks.title: Initialize detailed plan and task board
tasks.goal: Make implementation-plan.md and tasks.json authoritative for future Codex work.
scope: Compare docs/reference-tree.txt with the existing implementation plan.
Reflect the current dominic-nexus scaffold state.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/implementation-plan.md explains target phases and reference-tree mapping.
docs/tasks.json contains machine-readable tasks with status and dependencies.
No reference-openclaw files are modified.

tasks.title: Create feature parity checklist
tasks.goal: Track architecture parity without implying full provider/channel parity.
scope: Map reference domains to target packages.
Label each area as required, selected, deferred, or out-of-scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist covers runtime, config, permissions, secrets, tools, memory, providers, channels, plugins, UI, tests, and release.
Checklist explicitly says Dominic Nexus reimplements architecture patterns, not reference code.
Deferred provider/channel/media surfaces are separated from core security requirements.

tasks.title: Create security notes and trust model
tasks.goal: Document Dominic Nexus security assumptions before adding powerful tools.
scope: Define local operator boundary, trusted plugins, channel trust, secret handling, and telemetry policy.
List explicit differences from OpenClaw defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Shell, filesystem write, network, provider, plugin, and secret access are documented as deny-by-default.
The trust model says Gateway callers are not hostile tenants.
No silent telemetry and no secret logging are called out as hard requirements.

tasks.title: Document package boundary matrix
tasks.goal: Make allowed imports and ownership clear before packages grow.
scope: Define which packages may import shared, config, logging, permissions, secrets, memory, tools, providers, channels, plugin-sdk, and core.
acceptanceCriteria: Core orchestration boundaries are explicit.
Provider and channel packages cannot depend on core internals.
Plugin SDK exposes only public contracts.

tasks.title: Scaffold TypeScript pnpm monorepo
tasks.goal: Create the initial workspace and package structure.
acceptanceCriteria: dominic-nexus/package.json contains dev, build, typecheck, test, lint, and clean scripts.
Core package directories exist under dominic-nexus/packages.
CLI app exists under dominic-nexus/apps/cli.

tasks.title: Add baseline package exports
tasks.goal: Provide initial interfaces for every planned core package.
scope: shared, config, logging, permissions, secrets, memory, tools, providers, channels, plugin-sdk, and core package exports.
Simple runtime context and session creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Packages compile as ESM TypeScript.
Core can create a runtime context.
Tool and provider registries have baseline behavior.

tasks.title: Add scaffold regression tests
tasks.goal: Lock the initial behavior before deeper features are added.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover both allow and deny paths for sensitive operations.
CLI chat tests avoid external network calls.
Provider calls pass through permission checks.

tasks.title: Implement minimal CLI chat loop
tasks.goal: Make pnpm.cmd dev start a local interactive chat with no network calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty input does not call the provider.
/exit exits cleanly.
User messages and assistant responses are preserved in local loop state.

tasks.title: Make lint script meaningful
tasks.goal: Ensure pnpm.cmd lint runs a real check in each package or is intentionally documented.
scope: Add TypeScript-aware lint or a lightweight no-op policy only if documented.
Avoid adding heavy dependencies without justification.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm.cmd lint succeeds and provides useful signal.
Any new dependency is explained in docs or commit notes.
No generated files are committed.

tasks.title: Add shared branded IDs
tasks.goal: Avoid stringly typed session, agent, tool, provider, channel, and plugin IDs.
scope: Define branded ID types in packages/shared.
Add constructors or validators for runtime-created IDs.
Use IDs in core, tools, providers, and channels where practical.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionId, AgentId, ToolName, ProviderName, ChannelId, and PluginId are exported.
Existing tests compile after adopting the shared types.
ID helpers are deterministic in tests where needed.

tasks.title: Add shared result and error helpers
tasks.goal: Standardize expected failures without throwing raw errors everywhere.
scope: Define Result, AppError, error codes, and safe error serialization.
Adopt in config, permissions, tools, providers, and core where useful.
Keep thrown exceptions only at process boundaries or unexpected failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Permission/tool/provider failures can be serialized safely.
Errors do not include secret values.
Existing behavior remains covered by tests.

tasks.title: Add shared domain events
tasks.goal: Define a common event vocabulary before audit, Gateway, and UI depend on it.
scope: Define lifecycle, permission, provider, tool, memory, secret, session, and channel events.
Add tests for event shape compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Events include timestamp, eventId, sessionId when applicable, and source package.
Event payloads cannot contain functions or non-JSON values.
The event model can be used by audit and Gateway later.

tasks.title: Add deterministic runtime utilities
tasks.goal: Make tests stable without global Date.now or randomUUID patching.
scope: Inject into core session creation and audit events.
acceptanceCriteria: Session and event tests can use deterministic IDs and timestamps.
Production defaults still use real time and random IDs.
No global mutable test state is required.

tasks.title: Implement strict config schema
tasks.goal: Replace env-only config with validated source and runtime config.
scope: Reject unknown keys and malformed values.
Support explicit config file path for tests.
Keep environment overrides narrow and documented.
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed config fails closed.
Unknown config keys fail validation.
Runtime defaults are applied by pure functions.
Tests cover valid, invalid, unknown-key, and missing-file cases.

tasks.title: Add safe config write operations
tasks.goal: Allow future CLI/UI config edits without corrupting source config or secrets.
scope: Implement get, set, unset, merge, and replace primitives.
Prevent redacted placeholders from being written as real config.
acceptanceCriteria: Config writes are atomic enough for local use.
SecretRef values are preserved without logging resolved secrets.
Filesystem write permission is checked before mutation.

tasks.title: Add recursive log redaction
tasks.goal: Ensure logs never expose secret values or sensitive credential shapes.
scope: Redact known keys such as token, key, secret, password, credential, authorization, and cookie.
acceptanceCriteria: Logger tests prove nested sensitive values are redacted.
Non-sensitive context remains visible.
Redaction handles circular or invalid values safely if supported.

tasks.title: Add audit package or audit primitives
tasks.goal: Create an append-only event trail for sensitive actions.
scope: Add packages/audit or audit module in packages/core.
Define AuditEvent, AuditSink, InMemoryAuditSink, and redacted serializers.
Include timestamp, actor/session, action, decision, resource, and metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit events never include secret values.
Tests can assert emitted audit events deterministically.
Audit API is independent from CLI and UI.

tasks.title: Integrate audit into sensitive paths
tasks.goal: Record every provider, tool, secret, memory, config, and permission decision.
scope: Emit audit events from providers, tools, memory, secrets, permissions, and config writes.
Cover both allow and deny outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Deny decisions are audited.
Allowed sensitive actions are audited before or after execution with outcome status.
Tests verify no secret values enter audit metadata.

tasks.title: Expand permission decision model
tasks.goal: Represent allow, deny, approval-required, policy source, and audit metadata cleanly.
scope: Add decision kind or equivalent structured fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing policies still work after migration.
Interactive approval can express user-approved and user-denied decisions.
Tests cover risky and non-risky actions.

tasks.title: Use interactive approval policy in CLI runtime
tasks.goal: Avoid allow-all development behavior in interactive local use.
scope: Wire deterministic prompt IO into CLI runtime policy.
Prompt before provider.call and future risky actions.
Keep tests deterministic with prompt adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI provider calls require explicit approval unless config says otherwise.
Denied approval fails visibly without crashing the process unexpectedly.
Tests cover approve, deny, and invalid answer.

tasks.title: Implement filesystem root policy
tasks.goal: Bound all filesystem reads and writes to approved roots.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace-bound reads cannot escape approved roots.
Writes require filesystem.write permission.
Windows path edge cases are tested.

tasks.title: Define shell execution policy
tasks.goal: Keep shell disabled by default and make future execution auditable.
scope: Define ShellPolicy and execution request shape.
Validate command, cwd, env, timeout, and approval binding.
Reject risky env overrides such as PATH, LD_*, and DYLD_* unless explicitly allowed.
acceptanceCriteria: Default policy denies shell.execute.
Approval decisions bind to the exact command request.
Tests cover denied shell, approved shell metadata, and env guardrails.

tasks.title: Define network request policy
tasks.goal: Ensure every external request requires explicit permission.
acceptanceCriteria: Default policy denies network.request.
Network tools cannot bypass policy.
Tests cover denied and approved network metadata.

tasks.title: Implement SecretRef resolver
tasks.goal: Resolve active secrets into runtime snapshots without logging values.
scope: Represent unresolved active secrets as startup/reload failures.
Keep inactive unresolved secrets as warnings only when appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Secret values are not logged, thrown, or stored in audit events.
Active unresolved secrets fail closed.
Tests cover redaction and permission denial.

tasks.title: Add import boundary tests
tasks.goal: Prevent package coupling that would bypass policy boundaries.
scope: Add tests or scripts for disallowed imports.
Protect plugin-sdk from importing core internals.
Protect providers and channels from reaching around registries.
acceptanceCriteria: Boundary check fails on known-bad import examples.
Allowed import graph is documented in docs/package-boundaries.md.
Check runs in pnpm.cmd test or a documented script.

tasks.title: Expand RuntimeContext dependencies
tasks.goal: Make core orchestration use explicit dependencies instead of hidden globals.
scope: Add audit, memory, secrets, session store, clock, and id generator dependencies.
Keep provider, tool, config, logging, and permission dependencies explicit.
Update tests to use deterministic dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: RuntimeContext construction is pure and testable.
Core does not read process.env directly.
Core does not instantiate hidden global stores.

tasks.title: Implement durable session store
tasks.goal: Persist session metadata separately from transcripts.
scope: Track sessionStartedAt, lastInteractionAt, and updatedAt separately.
acceptanceCriteria: Sessions can be created, listed, loaded, and updated.
Background metadata writes do not incorrectly extend interaction freshness.
Filesystem writes require permission.

tasks.title: Implement transcript JSONL store
tasks.goal: Persist conversation events append-only per session.
scope: Append user, assistant, tool, lifecycle, and error events.
Serialize writes per session to avoid races.
acceptanceCriteria: Transcript files are JSONL and recoverable line by line.
Concurrent writes for the same session are serialized.
Tests cover append, read, malformed line handling, and write denial.

tasks.title: Implement AgentRunner turn lifecycle
tasks.goal: Move chat behavior from CLI wiring into core runtime orchestration.
scope: Call provider through registry and permission checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Core exports AgentRunner for later CLI and channel use.
Provider denials produce safe typed failures, runner/provider audit records, and error transcript events.
Tests cover successful turn, denied provider call, transcript persistence, awaited append ordering, append failure paths, and session metadata touch behavior.

tasks.title: Add event bus
tasks.goal: Let CLI, Gateway, audit, and UI observe runtime events without tight coupling.
scope: Emit lifecycle, session, provider, tool, and error events.
acceptanceCriteria: Events are emitted in deterministic order for a single turn.
Subscriber errors do not break core runtime unless configured.
Event payloads are redacted.

tasks.title: Add cancellation and timeout handling
tasks.goal: Bound provider and tool execution time.
acceptanceCriteria: Timed out turns produce audit and transcript events.
Cancelled operations do not emit success events.
Tests cover provider timeout and tool timeout.

tasks.title: Add session routing and queue policy
tasks.goal: Prepare runtime for channels and concurrent inbound messages.
scope: Define session keys for CLI and channels.
acceptanceCriteria: Core exposes deterministic CLI and channel routing key helpers.
AgentRunner serializes turns per routing key while separate routing keys can run concurrently.
Tests cover same-session ordering, separate-session concurrency, queue recovery, and JSON-safe routing keys.

tasks.title: Add ModelRef parser
tasks.goal: Parse provider/model refs with first-slash semantics.
scope: Split refs on the first slash because model ids may contain slashes.
acceptanceCriteria: openai/gpt-x parses provider=openai and model=gpt-x.
provider/vendor/model parses provider=provider and model=vendor/model.
Invalid refs fail with safe errors.

tasks.title: Expand provider interface and registry
tasks.goal: Support provider capabilities, model listing, and normalized execution.
scope: Add listModels or equivalent model catalog hook.
Add registry errors for missing providers and unsupported models.
acceptanceCriteria: MockProvider implements the expanded interface.
Registry can list providers and models.
Missing provider errors are safe and tested.

tasks.title: Centralize permission-gated provider execution
tasks.goal: Prevent callers from bypassing provider.call checks.
scope: Move provider execution behind registry or core service.
Emit audit events around provider calls.
Keep direct provider objects usable only inside tests or adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentRunner and CLI use the centralized execution path.
Denied provider calls are audited.
Tests prove provider adapters cannot be called by core without policy.

tasks.title: Add first real provider adapter
tasks.goal: Add one opt-in provider after secrets, config, permissions, and audit are stable.
scope: Add tests using mocked transport only.
acceptanceCriteria: No live network is used in unit tests.
Missing credentials fail closed.
Provider calls can be disabled by config/policy.

tasks.title: Add local provider placeholder
tasks.goal: Prepare for local model runtimes without making them mandatory.
scope: Define adapter shape for local HTTP or CLI model providers.
Keep network/shell policy explicit depending on transport.
acceptanceCriteria: Placeholder does not require installing a model runtime.
Tests use mocks only.
No background service starts automatically.

tasks.title: Add provider fallback and cooldowns
tasks.goal: Support configured fallback chains after basic provider behavior is stable.
scope: Distinguish strict user-selected models from configured defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: User-selected model failures fail visibly.
Configured defaults can fall back when policy allows.
Cooldown writes do not overwrite unrelated session state.

tasks.title: Add tool input and output schemas
tasks.goal: Validate tool calls before executing handlers.
scope: Validate input and safe output serialization.
Represent validation failures as safe errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid input never reaches a tool handler.
Validation errors are audited.
Echo tool and tests migrate to the new shape.

tasks.title: Implement central tool invocation pipeline
tasks.goal: Make permissions, audit, validation, timeouts, and redaction mandatory for all tools.
scope: Wrap all tool execution in one service.
Emit started, denied, failed, and completed events.
Prevent direct handler execution outside tests.
acceptanceCriteria: All required permissions are checked before handler execution.
Denied tool calls do not run handlers.
Audit events do not include sensitive inputs unless explicitly safe.

tasks.title: Add read-only filesystem tool
tasks.goal: Allow safe workspace reads through policy-gated tools.
scope: Respect file size limits and binary detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads outside approved roots fail.
Large or binary files are handled safely.
Tests cover Windows path normalization.

tasks.title: Add explicit-approval filesystem write tool
tasks.goal: Support controlled local edits after read tooling is safe.
scope: Write, create, and patch files under approved roots.
acceptanceCriteria: Writes outside approved roots fail.
Denied approval leaves files unchanged.
Tests cover create, update, denied write, and traversal attempts.

tasks.title: Add web fetch tool
tasks.goal: Support explicit-consent network fetches.
scope: Fetch URLs only after network.request permission.
Limit response size and content types.
Audit host, URL, decision, and result metadata without storing sensitive headers.
acceptanceCriteria: Default policy denies fetch.
Tests mock transport and do not use live network.
Redirect behavior is explicit and tested.

tasks.title: Add web search provider interface
tasks.goal: Prepare search as an optional network-backed capability.
scope: Keep search providers behind plugins or provider adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: No default live search provider is enabled.
Search requests are audited.
Tests use mocked search adapters.

tasks.title: Add shell tool disabled by default
tasks.goal: Support shell execution only through strict approval and audit.
scope: Implement shell tool request and result types.
Apply cwd, env, timeout, and output limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Default config disables shell tool.
Approved shell requests audit command, cwd, env metadata, and exit code.
Denied requests do not spawn a process.

tasks.title: Add memory tools
tasks.goal: Expose memory read/write through the same tool pipeline.
scope: Audit namespace and operation without leaking sensitive content unnecessarily.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory tools use MemoryStore instead of direct files.
Denied memory.write does not mutate memory.
Tests cover search and write through ToolRegistry.

tasks.title: Define durable memory model
tasks.goal: Move beyond in-memory records toward local-first durable memory.
scope: Define memory root and namespace behavior.
Separate memory records from session transcripts.
Document what memory writes require approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory model is documented in package types or docs.
Memory writes are permission-gated.
Existing InMemoryStore remains useful for tests.

tasks.title: Implement Markdown memory store
tasks.goal: Persist local memory in human-readable files.
scope: Support MEMORY.md under configured workspace/state root.
Add read, append, and replace operations as appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory file path is bounded to approved roots.
Writes require memory.write and filesystem.write where appropriate.
Tests cover read, write, denied write, and missing file behavior.

tasks.title: Add daily memory notes
tasks.goal: Support date-scoped local notes under memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md.
scope: Search across daily notes with limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Daily note paths are deterministic and root-bounded.
Invalid dates are rejected.
Tests cover append and search across multiple days.

tasks.title: Add keyword memory search
tasks.goal: Provide local search without a semantic/vector dependency.
scope: Limit result count and scanned bytes.
acceptanceCriteria: Search is deterministic and case behavior is documented.
Large memory files are bounded.
Tests cover multiple files and no-match results.

tasks.title: Move CLI chat through AgentRunner
tasks.goal: Keep CLI as an interface, not a runtime implementation.
scope: Replace direct provider calls in CLI with core AgentRunner.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI no longer assembles provider requests directly.
Chat turns persist transcripts when session store is configured.
Tests cover CLI input with AgentRunner mock or test runtime.

tasks.title: Add core slash commands
tasks.goal: Provide local operator controls inside chat.
scope: Keep slash command handling outside the model.
acceptanceCriteria: Slash commands do not call the provider.
Unknown slash commands return a clear local error.
Tests cover every initial slash command.

tasks.title: Add config CLI commands
tasks.goal: Let users inspect and update local config safely.
scope: Add config get, set, unset, validate, and path commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Config get never resolves or prints secret values.
Invalid set/unset operations fail without writing partial config.
Tests cover JSON stdout and human output modes.

tasks.title: Add secrets CLI commands
tasks.goal: Expose secret metadata and audits without exposing secret values.
scope: Add secrets list, check, and audit commands.
Keep direct secret reads behind permission and redaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Secret values are never printed.
Missing active secrets produce clear failure output.
Tests cover redaction in CLI output.

tasks.title: Add sessions CLI commands
tasks.goal: Allow users to list, inspect, and resume local sessions.
scope: Add sessions list, show, resume, and transcript path commands.
Read from session store and transcript store.
acceptanceCriteria: Sessions are listed with safe metadata.
Transcript output can be bounded by count or time.
Tests cover empty and populated stores.

tasks.title: Add security audit CLI command
tasks.goal: Give users a local security posture report.
scope: Check config path, state path, risky tools, network/provider settings, plugins, and secrets.
Report warnings and failures without exposing values.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit reports shell/network/provider/plugin risky states.
No secret values appear in audit output.
Tests cover safe and risky configurations.

tasks.title: Add JSON stdout mode
tasks.goal: Make CLI commands scriptable without parsing human text.
acceptanceCriteria: Config, sessions, providers, tools, plugins, and audit commands support JSON where relevant.
JSON mode writes logs to stderr or suppresses them safely.
Tests cover valid JSON output.

tasks.title: Design Gateway protocol
tasks.goal: Define the local control plane before implementing HTTP or WebSocket surfaces.
scope: Define request, response, error, event, and auth shapes.
Document local and tailnet trust assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Protocol docs avoid treating session IDs as auth.
WebSocket clients require first-frame connect.
Side-effecting methods include idempotency keys.
checks: pnpm.cmd typecheck if protocol types are added

tasks.title: Implement local Gateway process
tasks.goal: Host the runtime behind a local control plane.
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway does not bind publicly by default.
Startup fails closed on invalid config or active secret failures.
Tests cover startup, shutdown, and invalid config.

tasks.title: Add authenticated local HTTP API
tasks.goal: Expose status, sessions, config, and chat operations to local clients.
scope: Require local auth token or equivalent operator credential.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated calls fail.
Side-effecting calls require idempotency keys.
Provider and tool execution still uses permissions.

tasks.title: Add WebSocket event streaming
tasks.goal: Stream runtime events to CLI and future web UI.
scope: Require first frame to be connect.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid first frames close the socket.
Events are redacted and ordered per connection.
Tests cover connect, auth failure, and event delivery.

tasks.title: Add daemon lifecycle commands
tasks.goal: Let CLI manage local Gateway lifecycle.
scope: Add gateway start, stop, status, and logs commands.
Avoid background startup unless explicitly requested.
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway does not auto-start silently.
Commands work on Windows PowerShell.
Tests cover lifecycle state transitions with mocks.

tasks.title: Scaffold local web UI
tasks.goal: Create the operator UI only after Gateway contracts exist.
scope: Create or complete apps/web Vite app.
Connect only to local Gateway APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Web app starts locally.
No cloud telemetry or external analytics are added.
Build and tests are wired into workspace scripts.

tasks.title: Add web status and audit views
tasks.goal: Expose runtime health and sensitive action history.
scope: Filter by session, action, decision, and time.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit view never displays secret values.
Denied and allowed actions are distinguishable.
UI handles empty states and connection failures.

tasks.title: Add web chat and session views
tasks.goal: Provide a local UI for chat, transcripts, and session management.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat uses Gateway APIs, not direct provider calls.
Transcript rendering handles tool and error events.
Session actions require authenticated local operator access.

tasks.title: Add web settings and capability views
tasks.goal: Let users inspect config, providers, tools, plugins, and channels.
scope: Read and update safe config fields.
List providers, tools, plugins, and channels.
Show permission state and risky capability warnings.
acceptanceCriteria: Secret values are never displayed.
Risky toggles require explicit confirmation.
Config mutations go through Gateway and audit.

tasks.title: Define plugin manifest schema
tasks.goal: Support manifest-first plugin metadata without runtime import.
scope: Define id, name, version, description, capabilities, configSchema, and entry fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid manifests fail before plugin code loads.
Manifest parsing does not import runtime modules.
Tests cover valid and invalid manifests.

tasks.title: Implement plugin metadata discovery
tasks.goal: List installed plugin metadata without executing plugin runtime code.
scope: Reject path traversal and symlink escapes.
acceptanceCriteria: Discovery is read-only and root-bounded.
Invalid plugin metadata is reported safely.
No plugin entrypoint is imported during discovery.

tasks.title: Define narrow plugin SDK API
tasks.goal: Expose extension contracts without exposing core internals.
scope: Define PluginApi and capability registration types.
Avoid wildcard re-exports of internal packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin SDK can describe provider, tool, channel, and memory capabilities.
Plugin SDK does not import packages/core internals.
Boundary tests protect SDK exports.

tasks.title: Implement trusted plugin runtime loader
tasks.goal: Load explicitly enabled plugins into a narrow runtime API.
scope: Require plugin.execute permission or config allowlist.
Load entrypoint only after manifest validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Disabled plugins are not imported.
Enabled plugin load emits audit events.
Plugin failures do not corrupt global registry snapshots.

tasks.title: Register plugin capabilities
tasks.goal: Let plugins contribute providers, tools, channels, memory, and commands through registries.
acceptanceCriteria: Plugin capabilities appear in list commands.
Duplicate capability IDs fail safely.
Capability registration is audited.

tasks.title: Add minimal bundled example plugin
tasks.goal: Prove plugin manifest, discovery, loading, and capability registration end to end.
scope: Create one small local plugin under dominic-nexus.
acceptanceCriteria: Example plugin is disabled by default.
Enabling it requires explicit config or approval.
Tests cover discovery and load.

tasks.title: Define channel adapter contracts
tasks.goal: Normalize inbound and outbound messaging before real integrations.
scope: Define ChannelAdapter, InboundMessage, OutboundMessage, SenderIdentity, ThreadIdentity, and ChannelContext.
Keep provider and channel layers separate.
Avoid network dependencies in the core contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Contracts represent DM, group, room, thread, account, and sender metadata.
No channel contract imports provider internals.
Tests cover message normalization helpers.

tasks.title: Add local console channel adapter
tasks.goal: Exercise channel routing without external network.
scope: Adapt CLI-like input into channel messages.
Route outbound replies to local output.
Use same session routing as future channels.
acceptanceCriteria: Console channel uses core runtime and AgentRunner.
No external network or provider bypass is introduced.
Tests cover inbound normalization and outbound delivery.

tasks.title: Implement channel access policy
tasks.goal: Separate trigger authorization from supplemental context visibility.
scope: Require mention by default in group contexts.
Represent supplemental quoted/thread context visibility separately.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthorized inbound messages do not trigger the agent.
Group messages require mention unless configured otherwise.
Denied triggers are audited without leaking message content unnecessarily.

tasks.title: Add channel session routing
tasks.goal: Route channel messages to stable sessions.
scope: Map channel, account, room/thread, and sender identity to session keys.
Avoid treating session keys as auth.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages from different threads route to separate sessions when configured.
Routing metadata is persisted safely.
Tests cover DM and group routing.

tasks.title: Add outbound response shaping
tasks.goal: Prevent accidental bad channel output.
scope: Filter NO_REPLY and no_reply final answers.
Suppress duplicate visible confirmations from messaging tools.
acceptanceCriteria: NO_REPLY is never sent as user-facing text.
Duplicate tool confirmations are suppressed.
Tests cover final response shaping for channel output.

tasks.title: Add first external channel plugin
tasks.goal: Add one selected channel after secrets, network, plugins, and routing are stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel is disabled by default.
Inbound trigger policy is tested.
No live network is used in unit tests.

tasks.title: Define skill manifest and loader
tasks.goal: Support local skill folders without weakening plugin boundaries.
scope: Define skill metadata and entry files.
Load skill descriptions and assets read-only.
Reject symlink escapes from skill roots.
acceptanceCriteria: Skill discovery is read-only and root-bounded.
Invalid skill metadata fails safely.
Tests cover symlink/traversal guardrails.

tasks.title: Add skill CLI commands
tasks.goal: Let users list and inspect installed local skills.
scope: Add skills list and show commands.
Do not execute skill code during listing.
acceptanceCriteria: Skill values are shown as metadata only.
Invalid skills are reported safely.
Tests cover empty, valid, and invalid skill roots.

tasks.title: Add MCP abstraction
tasks.goal: Prepare optional MCP integrations behind permissions and audit.
scope: Route tool-like calls through permission and audit pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP is disabled by default.
MCP tool calls cannot bypass ToolRegistry policy.
Tests use local mocks only.

tasks.title: Add optional media and document capability slots
tasks.goal: Represent advanced media/document features as plugins, not core requirements.
scope: Define media understanding, media generation, document extract, speech, and browser automation capability types.
Do not enable providers by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Core runtime does not depend on media providers.
Capability slots can be listed and disabled.
Tests cover registration only, not live services.

tasks.title: Define test topology
tasks.goal: Organize unit, integration, boundary, CLI e2e, Gateway e2e, and web tests.
scope: Add package or root test config as needed.
Keep live/network tests separate and opt-in.
acceptanceCriteria: Default pnpm.cmd test does not require network.
Boundary and security tests run by default or a documented command.
Live tests are clearly opt-in.

tasks.title: Add security regression suite
tasks.goal: Continuously test the privacy and consent guarantees.
scope: Test path traversal and symlink escape prevention.
acceptanceCriteria: Security tests fail if risky defaults become permissive.
No secret value appears in logs, audit, or CLI output fixtures.
Tests run without live external services.

tasks.title: Add QA scenarios
tasks.goal: Capture end-to-end user workflows for local-first assistant behavior.
scope: Cover first run, approval denial, memory write, session resume, audit review, and disabled network.
acceptanceCriteria: QA scenarios map to task phases.
Core local scenarios can be run without cloud services.
Known limitations are documented.
checks: pnpm.cmd test if automated fixtures are added

tasks.title: Add packaging and release checklist
tasks.goal: Make releases repeatable once core behavior is stable.
scope: Document build, typecheck, test, lint, security, and package checks.
Define what artifacts are generated and ignored.
Avoid publishing or deployment automation until explicitly requested.
acceptanceCriteria: Release checklist is documented.
Build artifacts are ignored.
No deployment secrets are required for local checks.

tasks.title: Add container or deployment support
tasks.goal: Support optional packaging after local runtime is proven.
scope: Add Docker/container files only if needed.
